googleSheet.note: Manual tracker Kelvi updates himself when applying — the automated routine does NOT write to this. Per ROUTINE.md step 4, Sheets access turned out to be scope-restricted for the cloud routine, which uses job-hunt-seen-urls.json in Drive for dedup instead. This file (config.json) also isn't in the routine's fetch list (see ROUTINE.md step 1), so it's local-only reference, not live config.

schedule.emailPolicy: Send only when a run finds >=1 new match. No heartbeat email on zero-match runs — at 4 runs/day a per-run heartbeat would mean up to 4 emails/day of noise.
